description: ADR-0120 D12 natural-language selection corpus: per entry >=25 natural phrasings -> {entryId, args}, plus >=80 negatives. Agent-drafted; corpus approval delegated by the owner for the 2026-10-12 run (ADR-0120 ratification record, decision 5). S1 (2026-10-13, ADR-0121 S1 / ADR-0120 D6 Phase C): every entry with a frozen Class B grammar has at least 25 phrasings that grammar answers in Phase A (agent-drafted; the 148 S1 cases are PENDING the owner's batch approval under ADR-0120 D12 and are not approved yet), plus narrowing follow-ups without a previous selection and grammar-adjacent negatives.
